name: starwars-amplifone-1983
description: Star Wars (1983, Atari): colour vector on the Amplifone monitor (a 90-degree Rauland tube, P22 triad + shadow mask, 19.5 kV). Its party trick is documented HV-sag overdrive: the game deliberately overdrives the beam on the Death Star run, dragging the high voltage down, defocusing and blooming the whole screen. Faster draw speed than the WG6100 but blobby bright endpoints at high slew. Outline extraction with the halo gain and HV breathing pushed for that overdrive bloom.
